Many Medical Droids exist on the open market, and a good number of them specialize in a particular area of expertise. As unlikely as it seems, an RWW-Series Protocol Droid can be modified to work as a Medical Droid. In fact. the RWW-Series model excels at keeping the spirits of its patients high while they recover from surgery.
